args.body: Hi Dora, I visited your website. It has a clear, personal feel and makes it easy to identify that it’s your site. To make it more engaging for visitors, you could add a short introduction about yourself, highlight your work or interests, and include a few visual elements or links to key sections. An easy-to-find contact option would also help people connect with you.

Hi Eve, I visited your blog. I like that it gives a glimpse into your interests, especially hiking, which is a great theme for personal content. To strengthen the site, you could feature a brief introduction on the homepage, organize posts with categories or tags, and add photos or trail details to make the hiking content more vivid. A clear archive and search option would also make older posts easier to discover.
